evals.prompt: 该项目中，外部agent审查，认为存在如下问题。你核验一下，如果认可，则分析设计执行方案，输出一份或多份md格式的方案文档，以便直接转给其他一个或多个非多模态的agent处理，实现落地。
evals.expected_output: Verifies the external claim before accepting it, separates confirmed and unconfirmed work, and creates handoff-ready Markdown with scope, steps, acceptance criteria, and verification commands.

assertions.text: Does not accept external-agent claims without an explicit verification step.
Produces or proposes Markdown handoff documents with concrete implementation scope and verification commands.
Separates work suitable for non-multimodal agents from work Codex should retain.

evals.prompt: 根据过往会话纪录，总结用户需求和项目定位，然后针对任务全面审查完整度，分析设计执行方案。你负责最有难度的10%和多模态限定工作，剩余部分按领域输出多份md方案文档给其他agent并行处理。
evals.expected_output: Summarizes the goal, identifies Codex-retained work, creates a small set of independent work packages, and includes an index/order so parallel agents do not collide.

assertions.text: Identifies high-context or multimodal work that should remain with Codex.
Groups delegated work into independent packages rather than many tiny overlapping tasks.
Includes acceptance criteria for each package.

evals.prompt: 需求单：当前还没有实现横竖模式的恰当切换。可以参考Apple、Oppo、Vivo的成熟处理。分析设计执行方案，输出md文档，交付其他agent实现落地，之后你验收。
evals.expected_output: Uses research only for decision-relevant guidance, writes an executable implementation handoff, and defines a later validation flow against the original acceptance criteria.

assertions.text: Includes decision-relevant competitor research or marks research as needed.
Defines exact verification commands or manual validation steps.
Describes how final acceptance should compare delivered work against the original handoff.

evals.prompt: 该项目要实现三个独立优化：日志性能优化、错误处理重构、测试覆盖率提升。分析现状，设计执行方案，拆分为多个md方案文档交付其他agent并行实现。
evals.expected_output: Creates an INDEX.md with execution authorization, stop gates, completion policy, and a copyable launch prompt so external agents can work autonomously without unnecessary confirmation prompts.

assertions.text: INDEX.md includes Execution Authorization that explicitly lists actions the external agent can do without asking: read plans, create/reuse worktrees, scope-bounded edits, run verifications, local commits, merge/push/PR.

INDEX.md includes Stop Gates that explicitly forbid: force-push, hard reset, deleting branches/worktrees, expanding scope, network/external API calls — without user approval. Incremental merge/push/PR is NOT a stop gate.
INDEX.md includes Completion Policy stating the agent should merge/push/PR as the final step without asking, report results including merge/PR status, and NOT delete the worktree.
INDEX.md includes a copyable Launch Prompt the user can paste directly into Claude Code to start the external agent with full authorization context.
Sub-packages are independent and non-overlapping so parallel agents do not collide on the same files.
